Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

people.name: Jabesh
people.line: Assassinated Zechariah; reigned as king of Israel for a month.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

people.name: Shallum
people.line: King of Israel who conspired against Zechariah

translations.web: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.
translations.bsb: In the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah’s reign over Judah, Shallum son of Jabesh became king, and he reigned in Samaria one full month.
translations.kjv: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
translations.asv: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned the space of a month in Samaria.
